description: This Dart source file implements an agent service for a Flutter application, including exception handling, agent logic, tool setup, and utility functions for executing actions and processing commands related to a reactive AI agent employing tools and chat service integrations.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling agent-specific errors, with various error types and descriptive messages.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class managing the AI agent's operation, including message handling, reasoning loop, tool invocation, and state management.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's internal state, message history, and activity flags, notifying listeners.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the agent loop asynchronously based on user input, managing message flow, tool actions, and detecting stale runs.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a reasoning or action step to the agent's step list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes the set of tools available to the agent, such as file read/write, time retrieval, and calculation tools.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates simple mathematical expressions provided as strings.

methods.name: _tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes an expression string into components for parsing.

methods.name: _pE
methods.description: Parses addition and subtraction operations in expressions.

methods.name: _pT
methods.description: Parses multiplication and division operations in expressions.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors, including parenthesis and numeric values.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes a tool action command.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses comma-separated arguments within an action.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content from XML-like tags within a string.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the initial prompt guiding the agent's reasoning process, including available tools.
